parts.lesson_anchor: Starvation mitigations: priority aging and worker specialization; Exercises 2 and 5; lecture section 7.3 and 7.5
primary_traps: Filter actual arrival and each worker topic before priority; future and unsubscribed tasks cannot be admitted
